title: Initial Discussion
body: A first conversation about the project: the space, what you need from it and what you have in mind.

title: Paid Design Engagement
body: You appoint ROUANG to design the project, and the design work begins.

title: Design Development
body: The concept is developed into a full design, guided by the project’s purpose and your needs.

title: Project Proposal & Quotation
body: A proposal and quotation for carrying out the work, based on the developed design.

title: Construction
body: The works are carried out to the design, with coordinated planning, project management and quality control.

title: Handover
body: The completed space is handed over to you.
